userStories.title: Implement StayScore calculator algorithm
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core algorithm that computes StayScore (0-100) from multiple data sources.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/stayscore-calculator.ts exports function calculateStayScore() that returns total score and 6 sub-scores
Weights: wifi=0.25, workspace_room=0.20, workspace_hotel=0.15, coworking_proximity=0.15, price_productivity=0.15, traveler_rating=0.10
calculateWifiScore uses review sentiment (60%) + survey wifi_rating (weight grows with volume, 20%-70%) + amenity bonus (+5 for wifi listed)
calculateRoomWorkspaceScore uses review sentiment + survey workspace_adequate (SIM=100, PARCIAL=50, NAO=10) + category bonus (+10 for 4-5 star)
calculateCoworkingProximityScore uses count (max 40pts) + closest distance (max 30pts) + avg rating (max 30pts)
calculatePriceProductivityScore uses efficiency index: avgProductivity / normalizedPrice
calculateTravelerRatingScore uses Google rating (1-5 → 0-100) blended with survey would_recommend
All functions handle edge cases: no reviews, no surveys, no nearby workspaces
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implements all 6 sub-score calculators with correct weights. Handles edge cases for missing data.

Weekday prices are higher than weekend (15-30% variation)

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Deterministic via seeded PRNG. Realistic BRL pricing with weekday/weekend variation and hotel tier detection.
